hypothesis: Forward-only record, not a test of edge: pretend accounts (no orders) beside each bot, replayed nightly through this harness's simulator, can stand in for real accounts. universe: each bot's own asset list; the mirror holds whatever the real account holds, without owner-kept lines (core/bot_registry.py OWNER_KEPT)
window: forward only: from each twin's start (first run after this registration) to 31 Dec 2027; version 2 starts at the 21-22 Nov 2026 strategy lock
sizing: target weights of equity; fractional shares; a decision after a close fills at the next session's open (shares) or the next hourly bar's open (forex)
leverage: mirror: whatever the real account holds (gross cap 10 only as a sanity bound); baselines: no borrowing, gross <= 1.0 (2x funds carry the gearing)
costs: shares: research_harness/explore/gear_v1.COSTS (0 commission, 2 bps half spread, 3 bps slippage; cash earns 0; borrowing pays no financing). Forex: half spread measured per pair from 14 days of OANDA hourly bid/ask candles at the twin's start; financing and slippage beyond the spread OMITTED. The mirror check measures what the omissions cost.
pass_bar: Phase A: none for results (records only). Engine proof: mirror within Fable's tolerance; until set, a provisional guard of 1.0 percentage point (twins/config.py MIRROR_GUARD_PP) raises an alarm. AI-vs-bot pass marks are written by Fable before the first counted AI vote (spec rule 12).
